resolution:
We have forwarded your case to the Abandoned Vehicle Unit.  
	o If there is suspicious activity, you think the vehicle is stolen, located in a private lot, blocking traffic, sidewalks, fire hydrants, prepaid parking or a handicapped spot contact Denver Police Department non-emergency at (720) 913-2000. 
	o Otherwise, please call the Abandoned Vehicle Hotline at (720) 865-0471.
Once a car has been reported to the Abandoned Vehicle line, the Sheriff's Office will dispatch someone to mark the tires and post an Abandoned Vehicle Notice on the car. 

The Abandoned Vehicle Unit (AVU) has 2 deputies to service the entire City and County of Denver and, unfortunately, the AVU is unable to respond to complaints the same day but they will address complaints in the order in which they are received.  The timing on this will vary and there is no ETA.

resolution:
We have forwarded your case to the Abandoned Vehicle Unit.  
	o If there is suspicious activity, you think the vehicle is stolen, located in a private lot, blocking traffic, sidewalks, fire hydrants, prepaid parking or a handicapped spot contact Denver Police Department non-emergency at (720) 913-2000. 
	o Otherwise, please call the Abandoned Vehicle Hotline at (720) 865-0471.
Once a car has been reported to the Abandoned Vehicle line, the Sheriff's Office will dispatch someone to mark the tires and post an Abandoned Vehicle Notice on the car. 

The Abandoned Vehicle Unit (AVU) has 2 deputies to service the entire City and County of Denver and, unfortunately, the AVU is unable to respond to complaints the same day but they will address complaints in the order in which they are received.  The timing on this will vary and there is no ETA.
